channels.name: CLK_P
channels.purpose: Differential Clock Lane positive; DDR — both edges latch one Data-Lane bit.
channels.active_levels: HS differential 100-200 mV; LP 1.2 V single-ended
channels.idle_level: LP-11 (HIGH); HS-0 in Continuous Clock Mode

channels.name: DAT0_P
channels.purpose: Differential Data Lane 0 positive; carries CSI-2 packet bytes during HS.

logical_signaling_levels.name: LP-00
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Bridge state before HS or Escape entry

ordering_rules.bit_order_within_byte: LSB-first on the wire (bit 0 first, bit 7 last).
ordering_rules.byte_order_within_header: DI (byte 0) → WC[7:0] (byte 1) → WC[15:8] (byte 2) → ECC (byte 3); little-endian over the wire.
ordering_rules.byte_order_within_crc: CRC[7:0] first, then CRC[15:8] appended; CRC computed MSB-first over payload.
ordering_rules.multilane_byte_order: byte k → lane (k mod N); Sync byte replicated on every active lane.
ordering_rules.tx_rx_simultaneity: Source → sink during HS payload; bidirectional during LP escape; never both HS-driving at the same time.

dependency_graph.common_rule: Source drives Clock Lane (DDR) and all Data Lanes during HS; sink only receives HS. Both endpoints can drive LP states for escape signaling.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Each Data-Lane bit is sampled on a Clock-Lane edge (both edges, DDR). Header ECC validates DI+WC; payload CRC-16 validates payload.

handshake_pairs.name: HS_ENTRY
handshake_pairs.rule: LP-11 → LP-01 → LP-00 → HS-0 → Sync 8'b00011101; sink locks byte boundary on Sync.

handshake_pairs.name: ULPS_ENTRY
handshake_pairs.rule: Escape command code (e.g. 0x1E) → LP-00 held indefinitely.
